attempts.text:
Panchakanya school is not a designated evacuation point, so only Kakani shelter and Myagang hospital count as drop-offs. The Gajuri roads to Myagang and Kakani are flooded, so the only way to Gajuri is through Panchakanya.

**Strategy**
- **Benighat (4 injured, 4 children):** The only route is Kakani → Jwalamukhi → Benighat, 47 minutes each way. Each 94-minute round trip saves either 320 (injured) or 240 (children) in penalties, so we make two trips.
- **Jwalamukhi (4 adults):** A separate round trip would cost 80 minutes, the same as the 80 deferral penalty, because the car is full on both Benighat trips. We defer them.
- **Dupcheshwar (1 child) and Panchakanya (3 children):** The route Kakani → Dupcheshwar → Panchakanya → Myagang takes 83 minutes and saves 240. This fills the car exactly, and the plan ends at Myagang.
- **Gajuri (3 adults):** Rescuing them would need at least 112 extra minutes (Myagang → Panchakanya → Gajuri and back). That is more than the 60 deferral penalty, so we defer them.

drive car1 kakani-shelter jwalamukhi-school
drive car1 jwalamukhi-school benighat-school
load car1 injured 4
drive car1 benighat-school jwalamukhi-school
drive car1 jwalamukhi-school kakani-shelter
unload car1 injured 4
drive car1 kakani-shelter jwalamukhi-school
drive car1 jwalamukhi-school benighat-school
load car1 child 4
drive car1 benighat-school jwalamukhi-school
drive car1 jwalamukhi-school kakani-shelter
unload car1 child 4
defer jwalamukhi-school adult 4
drive car1 kakani-shelter dupcheshwar-farm
load car1 child 1
drive car1 dupcheshwar-farm panchakanya-school
load car1 child 3
drive car1 panchakanya-school myagang-hospital
unload car1 child 4
defer gajuri-market adult 3
</plan>

**Cost breakdown**
| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| Benighat trips: 2 × 94 minutes | 188 |
| Dupcheshwar/Panchakanya route: 23 + 27 + 33 minutes | 83 |
| Deferral penalty, Jwalamukhi: 4 adults × 20 | 80 |
| Deferral penalty, Gajuri: 3 adults × 20 | 60 |
| **Total** | **411** |

COST: 411
